governance.selection: 2022-2024 three-season LOSO full-I2 log loss, Brier tie-break

interpretation: Bottom-half underprediction is real, but correcting the half in isolation does not stably improve the primary full-I2 target. The precommitted winner fails 2026 replication, and both simpler components also worsen 2026.
decision: Reject all Phase 29C bottom-half corrections. Do not change park factors, bottom-half offset, or production.
next_phase: Test conditional top/bottom within-game dependence because current full-I2 Under probability multiplies the two exact half-inning scoreless probabilities; stable residual dependence could explain why half-level corrections do not translate to full-I2 improvement.
